title: Planted By
objective: Answer the label’s question plainly: write your name and ask to be there when it flowers, as a partner rather than a performer or a rescuer.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna takes you to the physic beds and hands you a trowel, handle first.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Kneel there. Mind the comfrey. Don’t eat the comfrey.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She kneels beside you with her gloves on and digs a hole exactly one knuckle deep. She checks it with the knuckle.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “The packet I kept for myself. It turned out to be relevant.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She drops in one seed and pats the soil over it. Then she takes a small wooden label from her apron, already written in her square capitals.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “*Helleborus niger.* Poisonous from root to petal. It flowers in the snow, when nothing else can be bothered.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “You were going to find out in three years. I moved it up.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I left a space. I measured it. One name wide.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I don’t know what goes in it. I’ve rubbed it out twice.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Pulse, fast. Hands, unreliable. Face, warm. I’d blame the sun, but there isn’t any.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She holds out the pencil from her bun. The sprig of rosemary comes with it and drops onto the soil.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Rosemary. For remembrance. That wasn’t on purpose.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “My mother sent me here to find someone who’d put up with me.”

options.labelText: “Senna, ever since you swatted a tart out of my hand, I’ve known. You’re the rarest thing in this garden. Marry me?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “That was a speech. I asked you a question.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “You rehearsed it. You did a hand gesture on *rarest*.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “It sounded better in my head.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She slides the label back into her apron. The space on it stays blank.

options.labelText: “Marry me, and you’ll never have to work in an infirmary again. I’ll look after you for a change.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “…Why would I want that?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “So you could rest. You never stop.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I like the infirmary. I moved in with four trunks. Nobody made me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She puts the label away in the pocket marked *sweets, for patients*. Then she goes back to weeding.

options.labelText: “Write my name. Marry me. I want to be here when it flowers, and every year after.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Senna looks at the label. Then at you, for longer.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Your name.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Spelled right, ideally.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes your name in the space and gets a letter wrong. She rubs it out with her thumb and tries again.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Don’t watch. My hands have stopped taking instructions.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The second try is perfect. She pushes the label into the soil beside the seed, then straightens it. Twice.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Yes, {PLAYER}. Obviously.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I’ve been diagnosing this for weeks.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “What’s the diagnosis?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Chronic. I looked for a cure. Then I stopped looking.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand. Her glove leaves soil on your fingers, and she doesn’t apologize for it.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I’ll write to my mother. One line. *Found someone. Stop underlining.*”
